Bug_Title: Invalid "Date" values should not be used
Bug_Explanation: The code incorrectly sets the month to 12, which rolls the date into January of the next year. Similarly, the Calendar object is initialized with the month as 12, causing it to roll to the next year. The comparison of Calendar.MONTH with 12 is also invalid, as the valid range for months is 0-11.

The bug manifests as the date rolling over to the next year, causing the month to be set to 0 (January), resulting in the test assertions failing.
